  "pros": [
    "Intuitive interface, making agent onboarding quick and easy.",
    "Good value for money compared to previous solutions.",
    "Reliable core ticketing and communication features."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Advanced customization and workflow automation could be more robust for complex fraud operations.",
    "Reporting capabilities are sometimes less detailed than desired for deep analysis.",
    "Integration with existing financial systems required some workarounds."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This team leader found Freshdesk to be a solid choice for managing customer service tickets and communications within their fraud operations team. They appreciated its user-friendly interface and good value, especially when compared to more expensive alternatives. While it capably handled core tasks, some advanced customization and reporting functionalities were not as comprehensive as they might have preferred for a large financial services organization."
